decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (2179-01/FP, 02/FPG, 03/FPG, 04/FPG, 05/FP received 19.09.11, 02179/06/FP rev H received 06.10.11) approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 6 - The means of access hereby approved shall not exceed a width of 2.4 metres and the boundary wall/fence shall be reinstated, except at the point of access which shall not exceed 0.6 metres in height.

Condition : 7 - The outbuilding hereby permitted must not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 41 Penbury Road. To do so would first require permission from the Council, obtained through the submission of a planning application and this is unlikely to be granted.

Condition : 8 - The hardstanding hereby approved shall be made of porous materials, or provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surface to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse.
description: Erection of a two-storey side extension, single-storey rear extension as well as a pitched roof to the existing outbuilding and change of the garage door to a residential door and window and a new means of access and hardstanding.
